x_axis.note: Use a conservative x-axis turn trial-speed curve: hold at 1% through 105mm, then ramp linearly to 20% by 180mm and clamp there.

y_axis.note: Use slower mast trial speeds when the brick is near the camera and ramp up linearly as distance increases during y-axis calibration trials, starting from the close-range ~49mm y reference.
